title: Listing quality and SEO across all reporting customers: cross-retailer parity, content floor, spec accuracy, freshness, sell-through beside quality, search position
acceptance_criteria: Checks per accepted decision D-0062 (Warren 2026-10-07), on every retailer covered by N-0085
Each check reads the stored snapshot; re-parse needs no re-fetch; results carry a rules_version and the snapshot age
A failing check is an amber flag with its evidence, never a hidden score and never a block; missing data shows as 'No data'
The Market & Listings quality lens shows one row per listing, a column per check, the flag count, snapshot age, and that product's weekly sell-through at the same retailer
Search position (second step): daily per retailer site search for Warren's terms, polite limits, its own table
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
